# GOLDAGRO Global Export

> Merchant exporter based in Thane (Mira Road East), Maharashtra, India. Two divisions: (1) Indian spices, fresh fruits and vegetables, (2) imitation jewellery. Sells to international B2B buyers in container / bulk quantities.

- GSTIN: 27HFFPK4882F1Z3
- Port of loading: Nhava Sheva (JNPT), Mumbai
- Incoterms: FOB Mumbai (JNPT), CIF to major ports
- Payment terms: T/T (advance + balance against documents) or L/C at sight
- Minimum order: usually one 20ft container; smaller trial orders may be possible
- Samples: available by courier; buyer pays courier charges
- Documents: commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading, certificate of origin, phytosanitary certificate (per shipment), lab reports on request

## Agro division (/)
- Spices: dry red chilli (Guntur/Teja), red chilli powder, green cardamom, nutmeg & mace, sesame seeds
- Vegetables: Nashik red onions, spinach, lemons, green peas, sweet corn
- Fruits: mosambi (sweet lime), G-9 Cavendish bananas, oranges, pineapple, apples

## Jewellery division (/jewellery)
- Imitation jewellery: necklaces, bridal sets, bangles, earrings; bulk and custom designs

## Registrations
- GST registration, Importer-Exporter Code (IEC, DGFT), FIEO RCMC membership (valid to 31/03/2027)

## How to enquire
Use the inquiry form on either page (opens WhatsApp or Gmail with the message pre-filled), or email / WhatsApp directly. Specifications, grades and availability are confirmed per lot before order.
